notes: Taken from the Board of Elections' 46-day election notice, which lists every contest and issue with the precincts that vote on it, checked against the Board's list of candidates and issues (which names the precincts). Issue wording is the Board's summary; the full wording is on the sample ballot.

Candidates are listed alphabetically by last name, not in ballot order: Ohio rotates the order of names from precinct to precinct. Certified write-in candidates are not printed on the ballot and are not listed.

"Where you live" uses the state voter file: a district or school levy is shown for a city, village or township when any of its voters live in that district. Your exact ballot depends on your precinct.
The Board's notice and candidates and issues list do not give local issue numbers; see your sample ballot for them.
